DECLARE @START_DTM DATETIME = ? DECLARE @END_DTM DATETIME = ?  DECLARE @START_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @START_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,@START_DTM))  DECLARE @START_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @START_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,@START_DTM))  DECLARE @END_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @END_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,@END_DTM))  DECLARE @END_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @END_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,@END_DTM))  DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()))  DECLARE @CURRENT_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE()))  DECLARE @OPEN_STATUS_ID INT SELECT @OPEN_STATUS_ID = STATUS_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS WHERE STATUS_DESC = 'Open'  DECLARE @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID INT SELECT @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'Potential'  DECLARE @PENDING_TASK_STATUS_ID INT SELECT @PENDING_TASK_STATUS_ID = STATUS_TYPE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TASK_STATUS WHERE STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Pending'  DECLARE @TYPE_ID INT SELECT @TYPE_ID = CASE_TYPE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_TYPE WHERE CASE_TYPE_DESC = 'Cancer'  DECLARE @CONCEPT_KEY INT SELECT @CONCEPT_KEY = CONCEPT_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CONCEPT  WHERE CONCEPT_NAME = 'CancNav_CBN_DialerCallBack' 	AND OPTION_VALUE = 'YES'  SELECT DISTINCT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER,NULL AS CALL_DUE_DATE,NULL AS NURSE_ASSIGNED,NULL AS TASK_CREATE_DATE,DC.CASE_ID,DCS.STATUS_DESC AS CASE_STATUS,DCP.PHASE_DESC AS CASE_PHASE,EFFDATE.DATE + EFFTIME.TIME AS CASE_EFF_DTM,TERMDATE.DATE + TERMTIME.TIME AS CASE_TERM_DTM,'NEW CASE' AS DIALER_RECORD_TYPE,CREATE_DD.DATE + CREATE_DT.TIME AS CASE_CREATE_DATE FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE DC ON DC.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK  		AND DC.CASE_ID LIKE 'CN%' 		AND (DC.CREATE_DATE > @START_DATE_KEY OR (DC.CREATE_DATE = @START_DATE_KEY AND DC.CREATE_TIME > @START_TIME_KEY)) 		AND (DC.CREATE_DATE < @END_DATE_KEY OR (DC.CREATE_DATE = @END_DATE_KEY AND DC.CREATE_TIME < @END_TIME_KEY)) 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC ON FC.CASE_KEY = DC.CASE_KEY 		AND FC.GROUP_CK = DC.GROUP_CK 		AND (FC.EFF_DATE < @CURRENT_DATE_KEY OR (FC.EFF_DATE = @CURRENT_DATE_KEY AND FC.EFF_TIME < @CURRENT_TIME_KEY)) 		AND (FC.TERM_DATE > @CURRENT_DATE_KEY OR (FC.TERM_DATE = @CURRENT_DATE_KEY AND FC.TERM_TIME > @CURRENT_TIME_KEY)) 		AND FC.STATUS_ID = @OPEN_STATUS_ID 		AND FC.PHASE_ID = @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID 		AND FC.CASE_TYPE_ID = @TYPE_ID 		AND FC.CASE_NAME = 'CM Cancer Navigator' 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON COP ON COP.CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON_ID = FC.CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON_ID 		AND COP.CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON_DESC IN ('CANav-Chemo','CANav-Rad/CA','CANav-EOL','CANav-Survivor','CANav-Surgery','CANav-PracticeReferral','CANav-Other') 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS DCS ON FC.STATUS_ID = DCS.STATUS_ID 	INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE] DCP ON FC.PHASE_ID=DCP.PHASE_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE CREATE_DD ON CREATE_DD.DATE_KEY = DC.CREATE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME CREATE_DT ON CREATE_DT.TIME_KEY = DC.CREATE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE TERMDATE ON TERMDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.TERM_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME TERMTIME ON TERMTIME.TIME_KEY= FC.TERM_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE EFFDATE ON EFFDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.EFF_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME EFFTIME ON EFFTIME.TIME_KEY= FC.EFF_TIME

DECLARE @START_DTM DATETIME = ? DECLARE @END_DTM DATETIME = ?  DECLARE @START_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @START_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,@START_DTM))  DECLARE @START_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @START_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,@START_DTM))  DECLARE @END_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @END_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,@END_DTM))  DECLARE @END_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @END_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,@END_DTM))  DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()))  DECLARE @CURRENT_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE()))  DECLARE @OPEN_STATUS_ID INT SELECT @OPEN_STATUS_ID = STATUS_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS WHERE STATUS_DESC = 'Open'  DECLARE @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID INT SELECT @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'Potential'  DECLARE @OPEN_ACTIVE_PHASE_ID INT SELECT @OPEN_ACTIVE_PHASE_ID = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'Open/Active'  DECLARE @TYPE_ID INT SELECT @TYPE_ID = CASE_TYPE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_TYPE WHERE CASE_TYPE_DESC = 'Cancer'  DECLARE @CONCEPT_KEY INT SELECT @CONCEPT_KEY = CONCEPT_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CONCEPT  WHERE CONCEPT_NAME = 'CancNav_CBN_DialerCallBack' 	AND OPTION_VALUE = 'YES'  SELECT DISTINCT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER,DUE_DD.DATE + DUE_DT.TIME AS CALL_DUE_DATE,DU.LOGIN AS NURSE_ASSIGNED,FT.MEMBER_TASK_ID AS TASK_ID,CREATE_DD.DATE + CREATE_DT.TIME AS TASK_CREATE_DATE,DC.CASE_ID,CASE_CREATE_DD.DATE + CASE_CREATE_DT.TIME AS CASE_CREATE_DATE,DCS.STATUS_DESC AS CASE_STATUS,DCP.PHASE_DESC AS CASE_PHASE,EFFDATE.DATE + EFFTIME.TIME AS CASE_EFF_DTM,TERMDATE.DATE + TERMTIME.TIME AS CASE_TERM_DTM,'CALL BACK' AS DIALER_RECORD_TYPE FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_FORM DF 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_TASK FT ON FT.TEMPLATEID = DF.FORM_ID 		AND (FT.CREATE_DATE > @START_DATE_KEY OR (FT.CREATE_DATE = @START_DATE_KEY AND FT.CREATE_TIME > @START_TIME_KEY)) 		AND (FT.CREATE_DATE < @END_DATE_KEY OR (FT.CREATE_DATE = @END_DATE_KEY AND FT.CREATE_TIME < @END_TIME_KEY)) 		AND FT.COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL 		AND FT.SUBJECT = 'Cancer Navigator Callback Note' 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TASK_STATUS DTS ON FT.TASKSTATUS_ID = DTS.STATUS_TYPE_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM FMF ON FMF.FORM_KEY = DF.FORM_KEY 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM_CONCEPT FMFC ON FMF.MEMBER_FORM_KEY = FMFC.MEMBER_FORM_KEY 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG DFCC ON DFCC.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY = FMFC.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY 		AND DFCC.CONCEPT_KEY = @CONCEPT_KEY 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM ON DM.MEME_CK = FT.MEME_CK 	LEFT OUTER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_USER DU ON DU.USER_ID = FT.USER_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE DC ON DC.MEME_CK = FT.MEME_CK  		AND DC.CASE_ID LIKE 'CN%' 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC ON FC.CASE_KEY = DC.CASE_KEY 		AND FC.GROUP_CK = DC.GROUP_CK 		AND (FC.EFF_DATE < @CURRENT_DATE_KEY OR (FC.EFF_DATE = @CURRENT_DATE_KEY AND FC.EFF_TIME < @CURRENT_TIME_KEY)) 		AND (FC.TERM_DATE > @CURRENT_DATE_KEY OR (FC.TERM_DATE = @CURRENT_DATE_KEY AND FC.TERM_TIME > @CURRENT_TIME_KEY)) 		AND FC.STATUS_ID = @OPEN_STATUS_ID 		AND FC.PHASE_ID = @OPEN_ACTIVE_PHASE_ID 		AND FC.CASE_TYPE_ID = @TYPE_ID 		AND FC.CASE_NAME = 'CM Cancer Navigator' 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON COP ON COP.CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON_ID = FC.CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON_ID 		AND COP.CUSTOM_OPEN_REASON_DESC IN ('CANav-Chemo','CANav-Rad/CA','CANav-EOL','CANav-Survivor','CANav-Surgery','CANav-PracticeReferral','CANav-Other') 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS DCS ON FC.STATUS_ID = DCS.STATUS_ID 	INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE] DCP ON FC.PHASE_ID=DCP.PHASE_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE DUE_DD ON DUE_DD.DATE_KEY = FT.DUE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME DUE_DT ON DUE_DT.TIME_KEY = FT.DUE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE CREATE_DD ON CREATE_DD.DATE_KEY = FT.CREATE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME CREATE_DT ON CREATE_DT.TIME_KEY = FT.CREATE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE CASE_CREATE_DD ON CASE_CREATE_DD.DATE_KEY = DC.CREATE_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME CASE_CREATE_DT ON CASE_CREATE_DT.TIME_KEY = DC.CREATE_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE TERMDATE ON TERMDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.TERM_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME TERMTIME ON TERMTIME.TIME_KEY= FC.TERM_TIME 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE EFFDATE ON EFFDATE.DATE_KEY= FC.EFF_DATE 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME EFFTIME ON EFFTIME.TIME_KEY= FC.EFF_TIME
